verify: a store past the driver's capacity

rejection_exactness_gaps: memory rejections that quote a decoded declaration, a pointer type the memory engine's pointer decoder rejects, and a stack-owner entry's contract decline (ADR-293, ADR-297); a group member function's own graph check, a missing reference first reached through another object's graph, and rejections inside nested build decoders decline (ADR-288, ADR-297)
ordinary_evolution: the compiler's transaction engine (S15d.1) changes operations and constants only; structural changes (nodes, uses, signatures, new functions) still need the Python builders (S15d.4)
